original.target_description: Study 1: Studio 17 versus Studio 97, average restaurant meal (weak internal reference price), not hamburger or follow-up address conditions; one-factor test.

n.exclusions: 115 recruited across average-meal and hamburger conditions; analytic n for average-meal comparison is not explicitly printed. No n derived from df.
n.location: p. 611 (supplied locator), Study 1 Methods/Results; author full-text HTML sections 4.1–4.2, lines 405–438
n.quote: We recruited 115 participants using Amazon MTurk.

es.location: p. 611 (supplied locator), section 4.2 Results, HTML lines 422–438

p.location: p. 611 (supplied locator), section 4.2 Results, HTML line 424

replication.target_description: Study 1: Restaurant item, Studio 97 versus Studio 17, independent-samples comparison of willingness-to-pay estimates after outlier exclusions.

n.location: p.5, Table 1, Restaurant row, High n and Low n columns
n.sample_role: Participants contributing one restaurant estimate each to the independent two-group test; sum of mutually exclusive final High and Low anchor groups.
n.exclusions: Item-specific outliers more than 1.5 IQR from the extreme of the IQR excluded; p.4 reports 5.56% across all observations, not a restaurant-specific percentage. Recruitment N=144 is not used as analytic N.

p.quote: the low anchor group but the difference fell far short of ... statistical significance (p = .26)

reported_success.quote: We were unable to find any statistically ... significant difference in price estimations between ... Studio 17 and Studio 97.

notes:
Matching uses only supplied study/outcome/locator. Indistinguishable repeated locators are extracted identically; no item or subgroup is inferred from audit ID or input order. Printed group ns retained separately, without computing a total. Original printed η² is retained rather than converting to requested d. Analytic subgroup n is unprinted. Source is primary author-uploaded full-text HTML, cached as selected web-extracted text.
